title: Source hypotheses require evidence
summary: Prefer plausible authored C++ supported by local source, assembly, mario.MAP and objdiff; leave uncertain work nonmatching, with no comment in the source.
Use mario.MAP and debug strings for names, signatures, class structure and original helper boundaries.
do: Use matched siblings, original symbols, headers, debug strings and the map.
Recover owning types, methods, enums and helpers rather than raw offsets or invented storage.
Use SMS enums, and accessors that an upstream header, the map or a sibling decomp shows at this call site (sms-accessor-evidence).
Keep declarations in their owning headers and preserve known virtual methods and vtable order.
do_not: Treat decompiler output as stronger evidence than the binary.

Call __fabsf, __frsqrte, __fres or another MSL intrinsic directly where the public wrapper exists; a direct intrinsic call is flagged for review, not rejected outright. Accessor and inline swaps belong to sms-accessor-evidence.

Define a placeholder class at file scope in a .cpp; the owning header (per the map unit of __vt__/__dt__/__ct__) declares it, with no marker comment. A placeholder whose map symbols belong to another unit is rejected; one with no header and no map conflict is flagged for review, not rejected.
provenance: Merged sms-names-types-helpers on 2026-09-16 (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 5); sms_local_class_needs_owner rebound here. The no-HSD sentence stays until the Melee-token leak in the global records is fixed. 2026-10-13: TODO/fabricated marker advice and the getUnkNN flip moved out (SMS maintainer ruling (Mrkol, Discord, 2026-10-13); doldecomp/sms #330/#331).

title: Use SMS C++ and formatting conventions
summary: Use MWCC GC/1.2.5-compatible C++98 and upstream clang-format 21 configuration.
do: Use tabs for indentation, 80 columns and the WebKit-based upstream .clang-format.
Preserve include order and use project-relative angle-bracket includes.
Preserve the existing RTTI, exception and per-TU compiler flags.
do_not: Introduce C++11 language features.
Apply Melee include sorting or formatting rules.

title: Autonomous edits stay in game code
summary: Do not edit SDK, JSystem, MSL, MetroTRK or THPPlayer in an autonomous attempt.
preferred_repairs: Select src/Enemy or another game-owned target.
do: Work on game-owned classes and functions.
Read library interfaces as evidence without changing them.
do_not: Modify vendor or middleware code to improve a target score.

title: Keep the initial experiment reviewable
summary: The initial SMS experiment improves existing game code rather than opening fresh decompiled translation units. Prefer bounded vector-math or inline-callsite improvements supported by evidence.
do: Choose an existing game-owned function with enough source and binary context.
Treat TVec3 signatures as research evidence.
Keep the patch bounded to what a maintainer can review.
do_not: Generate new TUs that require a broad cleanup pass.
provenance: Set workflow_only on 2026-09-16 (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 6): run intent, not a worker requirement. JSystem restatements pruned; sms-game-code-only owns the vendor-edit prohibition.

title: Reconstruct UNUSED bodies and validate map symbols
summary: Recover UNUSED dead-stripped functions from their surviving inline call sites where possible, then compare compiled sizes with mario.MAP. Validate each changed C++ translation unit against the map.
Extract the maximum relevant information from SMS symbol maps and corroborating maps from other games. Keep provenance explicit and do not import unsupported assumptions.
qa_enforcement: required_fresh_object_and_upstream_map_validation_with_review_of_size_warnings. Enforced by the harness since 2026-09-17: the symbol_validation worker micro gate and the boundary/Sync symbol-check task run the checkout's own tools/check-changed-symbol-order.py --baseline-dir <base-revision build> inside the game sandbox (the image bakes orig/GMSJ01/files/mario.MAP); new missing/order/binding errors versus the base revision fail the attempt or block acceptance, inherited errors are reported. The review_lint rule sms_symbol_map_validation is only the pr_gate reminder (severity info) and the worker surface skips it.
do: Extract names, signatures, presence, ordering, linked binding and known UNUSED sizes from the map.

Record which maps, revisions and symbols support a name, signature, class shape or inline hypothesis; compare related-game maps where available and record missing corroborating sources rather than inventing evidence.
Trace all relevant inline call sites to reconstruct an UNUSED body, including assert stubs and real helper boundaries.
Preserve validator output, including UNUSED size warnings; a warning is an unresolved hypothesis, not proof of a match.
Account for reverse emission under -inline deferred.
do_not: Skip map validation because the object is missing or the file is untracked.
Infer UNUSED linkage from the UNUSED marker.
Fill an UNUSED body with invented code merely to match its size.
Ignore known map information in favor of a decompiler guess.
Assume a same-named method in another game has the same ABI or implementation.
provenance: Merged sms-map-research on 2026-09-16 (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 5); the CI gate description moved from do to qa_enforcement.

title: Names require maintainer review
summary: Preserve existing names in autonomous output. Propose inferred semantic names separately for explicit maintainer review; evidence alone is not naming approval.
This record overrides global conservative-naming for SMS: no autonomous rename, evidenced or not.

Enforcement: renaming an existing member, function, type, file-scope static/global, parameter or symbol-map name gets a review warning on worker attempts and is rejected by the PR gate until a maintainer integrates the name. Ordinary new locals inside a function body are not renames and are never flagged.
do: Keep existing function, type, member, parameter, local and symbol-map names.
Record a proposed name with its original name, location and evidence for human review.
Have a human integrate approved naming changes separately into the accepted base before resuming automated matching.
do_not: Automatically rename a symbol because the model believes it understands the role.
Suppress a naming finding with a comment or self-authored approval.
provenance: Macro-alias bullet pruned on 2026-09-16 (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 5); global define_alias owns alias detection. Rule narrowed to genuine rename candidates (old name gone from the post-change file, not a function-body local) with worker warning / pr_gate error on 2026-09-16 after a 1,046-integration replay showed it firing on ordinary new locals.

title: Retained changes require baseline and regression evidence
summary: Create a baseline before edits and run changes_all after them. Preserve local work and report per-symbol regressions.
preferred_repairs:
ninja baseline
# make scoped changes
ninja changes_all
do: Run ninja baseline before matching work and ninja changes_all afterward.
Use narrow object builds and objdiff/decomp-diff evidence for the target.
Validate affected neighbors when changing headers, data, inlining or symbol order.
do_not: Reset or discard pre-existing work.
Claim a match from an aggregate percentage alone.
provenance: Set workflow_only on 2026-09-16 (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 6): build and objdiff commands belong to validation config, not the worker block.

title: Match up to the stack frame; never shape the frame
summary: AI matching in SMS stops at the stack frame. A function whose only remaining difference from the target is the stack frame (the frame size in stwu r1,-N(r1) and the N(r1) stack offsets that move with it) is done: leave it nonmatching, with no comment, and fix other mismatches first.

Banned when their only effect is the frame: PAD_STACK or any padding macro; dummy, unreferenced or partially used locals of any type, with or without volatile; discarded constructor expressions; alignment tricks such as union { u64 alignment; char data[0x100]; } buf; or ATTRIBUTE_ALIGN / __attribute__((aligned)) on locals; choosing which inlines to call to force the frame size; operand swaps such as 0 <= x for x >= 0.

Extra locals, operand swaps and declaration changes are normal matching when they change other codegen. The test: build with and without the edit and diff the objects (toolpacks/gamecube-decomp/_impl/gamecube/tools/stack_check.py hunks, or stack_check.py objects A.o B.o). If only stwu/addi r1 frame immediates and N(r1) or addi rX,r1,N stack offsets differ, the edit is stack-only and banned; if registers, instructions, branches, relocations or data differ, it is normal matching.

This record overrides the global matching-tactics evidence exception for SMS: frame padding is never retained, with or without objdiff evidence or a marker comment. Melee allows PAD_STACK; SMS does not.
preferred_repairs: Remove the frame-only edit and stop: the function stays nonmatching, with no comment.
do: Fix register, instruction, branch, relocation and data mismatches first; stop when only the frame differs.
Investigate every relevant inline, including (void)0 assert stubs, from headers, the map and sibling decomps before attributing a difference to the frame.
Use evidence to reconstruct member visibility, method signatures and helper boundaries.
Before keeping an extra local, operand swap or declaration change, build both ways and compare; keep it only when non-stack codegen changes.
Report actual objdiff scores, the remaining frame difference and tested hypotheses in the attempt summary, not in the source; do not relabel a partial match as 100%.
do_not: Use PAD_STACK or any padding macro.

Commit char trash[4], volatile arrays, renamed unused arrays, unreferenced locals (Mtx44 transform; TVec3 position; const T& tmp = ...;) or a single-component aggregate local (half.x) to shape the frame.
Write JGeometry::TVec3<f32>(); or another discarded constructor expression as a statement.
Use alignment tricks: union { u64 alignment; char data[0x100]; } buf;, ATTRIBUTE_ALIGN or __attribute__((aligned)) on locals.
Swap comparison operands (0 <= x for x >= 0), add locals or pick different inlines when the only effect is the frame size.
Leave a TODO, nonmatching, fakematch or frame-size comment in the source.
provenance: Merged sms-stack-independent-matching on 2026-09-16 (audits/sms-worktree-source-quality-2026-09-16/ALIGNMENT.md section 5); pragma marking moved to sms-fabricated-marker. Owns discarded-constructor findings in SMS: the sms_baseline post-scan hook drops the global discarded_expression finding on a line where sms_dummy_stack_padding reported a discarded constructor. Rewritten 2026-10-13 for the SMS maintainer ruling (Mrkol, Discord, 2026-10-13): frame-only work stays nonmatching with no comment; PAD_STACK, alignment tricks and frame-only operand swaps added (sms_pad_stack_macro, sms_alignment_trick, sms_operand_flip).

title: A matching tactic must change non-stack codegen
summary: In SMS a tactic (declaration order, widened local lifetime, extra or layout-cue local, argument reordering, operand swap, guard removal, cancelling arithmetic, fixed function pointer, volatile local) is normal matching only when it changes non-stack codegen. Build with and without it and diff the objects (toolpacks/gamecube-decomp/_impl/gamecube/tools/stack_check.py hunks); a stack-only difference means remove it.

Stack padding is never allowed in SMS, with or without objdiff evidence (sms-temporary-tactics). A fabricated helper is not evidence, and a marker comment does not make a tactic acceptable (sms-fabricated-marker).
This SMS record replaces the global matching-tactics record for SMS workers.
do: Try clean source first; keep a tactic only when the build-both-ways diff shows a register, instruction, branch, relocation or data change.
Check adjacent functions when a tactic can perturb codegen, data order or local stack shape.
Remove the tactic once the real type, control flow, data ownership or inline is understood.
do_not: Keep a tactic whose only effect is the stack frame size or r1 offsets.
Introduce a helper, inline or local to explain the stack shape.
Mark a tactic with // fabricated, // TODO or an objdiff note to keep it.
Add UNUSED u8 sp_pad[N], a padding macro or any dummy local buffer.
preferred_repairs: Clean source first; a tactic stays only when stack_check.py shows a non-stack codegen change.
Replace local extern or inlining steering with the real source structure or the header inline.
Where only the frame differs, remove the tactic and leave the function nonmatching with no comment.
provenance: SMS override of the global record (same id; the SMS slice wins for SMS workers). Written 2026-10-13 for the SMS maintainer ruling (Mrkol, Discord, 2026-10-13): the global evidence exception, marker acceptance and TODO advice do not apply to SMS.
